candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return Digital Surface Model (FZ_DSM) - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m first-return DSM covers about 99% of England and includes heights of objects as well as terrain where the first/only return is ground.
It is derived from National LIDAR Programme data, referenced to ODN, uses OSTN15 and constituent surveys carry a stated +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: First-return DSM is not a bare-earth DTM; 1m spatial resolution must not be interpreted as 1m vertical accuracy or automatic parcel-ground suitability.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return Digital Surface Model (FZ_DSM) - 2m
verified_facts: The 2m first-return DSM has the same object-inclusive first-return semantics with 2m spatial resolution.
The source record documents survey merge lineage, ODN vertical reference, OSTN15 transformation and the constituent-survey vertical accuracy contract.
semantic_limits: Changing horizontal grid resolution from 1m to 2m does not define vertical uncertainty and neither first-return DSM should replace a bare-earth terrain product without explicit justification.
